skill.name: seo-snippet-hunter
skill.description: Formats content to be eligible for featured snippets and SERP features. Creates snippet-optimized content blocks based on best practices. Use PROACTIVELY for question-based content.
skill.summary: Creates concise SEO answer blocks for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and SERP content formats.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Search content often misses featured snippet opportunities because answers are buried or poorly structured. This skill turns questions, definitions, lists, and tables into concise snippet-ready blocks.
actual_capabilities: Formats answers for paragraph, list, and table snippet opportunities.
Creates concise question-and-answer blocks for People Also Ask targets.
Recommends FAQPage and HowTo schema structures at a planning level.
Suggests placement strategies for answers near the start of content.
Creates multiple answer variations for the same search intent.
limitations: It does not guarantee search ranking or snippet ownership.
It does not perform live SERP scraping by itself.
It needs accurate source content, target keywords, and search questions.
Schema suggestions require technical validation before publication.

use_cases.title: Refresh Blog Answers
use_cases.description: Turn long blog sections into direct answers, lists, and FAQ entries that match common search questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Comparison Pages
use_cases.description: Structure product attributes, pros, and decision criteria into clear tables and answer blocks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Editorial Briefs
use_cases.description: Create snippet-focused outlines with target questions, answer formats, and supporting detail requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Format One Answer
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one target question.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-snippet-hunter skill to format this answer for a featured snippet. Target question: [question]. Source facts: [facts].

prompt_templates.title: Create FAQ Blocks
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for People Also Ask coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-snippet-hunter skill to create six concise FAQ answers for these search questions: [questions]. Keep each answer direct and factual.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Draft Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for improving existing content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-snippet-hunter skill to revise this section for paragraph, list, and table snippet formats. Preserve the meaning and flag missing facts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Snippet Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a full content plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the seo-snippet-hunter skill to create a snippet optimization plan for this page. Include target questions, answer formats, placement notes, and schema recommendations.

output_examples.input: Question: What is customer segmentation? Source facts include groups, shared traits, and marketing personalization.
output_examples.output: Customer segmentation is the process of dividing customers into groups based on shared traits. It helps teams personalize messages, offers, and product experiences for each group.

output_examples.input: Question: How do you clean a reusable water bottle?
output: Rinse the bottle with warm water.
Add mild dish soap and scrub the inside.
Clean the cap and seal separately.
Rinse fully and air dry before closing.

output_examples.input: Topic: Compare monthly and annual software billing for buyers.
output_examples.output: A comparison table should show price, commitment length, cancellation flexibility, discount level, and best-fit buyer type.

best_practices: Provide verified source facts before asking for optimized answers.
Use exact target questions as headings when possible.
Keep the direct answer near the beginning of the section.
anti_patterns: Do not invent facts to make an answer sound complete.
Do not stuff keywords into every sentence.
Do not rely on schema suggestions without implementation review.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes content structure for featured snippets, People Also Ask answers, FAQ sections, and comparison tables.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee a featured snippet?
faq.answer: No. It improves formatting and clarity, but search engines decide rankings and snippet selection.

faq.question: Can it analyze live search results?
faq.answer: No. It can use SERP data that you provide, but it does not fetch live results by itself.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use target questions, primary keywords, source facts, competitor notes, and the draft content to optimize.

faq.question: Can it create schema markup?
faq.answer: It can recommend FAQPage and HowTo structure, but implementation should be checked by a developer or SEO tool.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
